name: DOI Publications
description: Provides a search and service for DOI (Digital Object Identifier) publications.
project_description:
Features: 

 This module provides a service (doi_search.manager) that allows retrieving information publications using DOI ( https://www.doi.org/ ).

Usage example: $data = \Drupal::service('doi_search.manager')->getData({DOI})

 It also provides a search page in /doi-search were you can search for the publications.

 The API used can be consulted here http://api.crossref.org/swagger-ui 

 Configuration: 

 Configure the permissions in /admin/people/permissions/module/doi_search
